name: Kiwoom Securities Co., Ltd.
summary: Kiwoom Securities Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, provides online brokerage services in South Korea and internationally. The company offers online trading system to trade in foreign stock, local and overseas futures, and F/X margin trading, as well as equity, futures, and option deals. It also provides derivatives and futures trading services; and equity capital market services, such as initial pricing offering and recapitalization, as well as recruiting and underwriting of bonds, including convertible bonds and bonds with warrant. In addition, the company offers debt capital market services comprising underwriting corporate debt and asset-backed securities, and liquidating assets…
